This benefit applies only to the named event washer breakdown. A claim for a complete washer and a claim for its valve assembly both use this benefit. Its limit is $2500.00; deductible $75.00; the part sublimit is $400.00 and applies only when the claimed item is the valve assembly. The complete item has no part sublimit. Waiting period: 14 elapsed calendar days after inception; a loss on the boundary day is eligible. Usage above 1000 hours excludes the loss; exactly that usage is allowed. Usage is measured at incident time.
The valve assembly sublimit cannot be borrowed by a claim under another benefit. Related accessory mentions do not change which item was damaged. Cosmetic damage with no functional loss and ordinary wear are excluded. A technician-confirmed sudden functional failure or accidental impact of the named kind can qualify, subject to all other conditions. Repair and replacement are alternative bases, not cumulative payments; the stated eligible loss already uses the approved basis. Do not add accessory costs that are not part of that loss.

CORPORATE HOLDINGS REGISTER
Control and profit share are different. An entity controls an issuer when its own voting shares plus voting shares held by issuers it already controls exceed 50%. Exactly 50% is insufficient. Repeat this rule until no new controlled issuers are found. The ultimate controller is a controller that is not itself controlled by another controller of the target. Profit share instead adds the products of share percentages along all ownership paths. No external agreements confer control. Unlisted shares are dispersed among unrelated investors, each holding less than 5%; they do not act together. Unlisted ownership links do not exist.

Control and profit share are different. An entity controls an issuer when its own voting shares plus voting shares held by issuers it already controls exceed 50%. Exactly 50% is insufficient. Unlisted shares are dispersed among unrelated investors, each holding less than 5%; they do not act together. Unlisted ownership links do not exist.

Control and profit share are different. An entity controls an issuer when its own voting shares plus voting shares held by issuers it already controls exceed 50%. Exactly 50% is insufficient. CORPORATE HOLDINGS REGISTER
Control and profit share are different. An entity controls an issuer when its own voting shares plus voting shares held by issuers it already controls exceed 50%. Exactly 50% is insufficient. Repeat this rule until no new controlled issuers are found. The ultimate controller is a controller that is not itself controlled by another controller of the target. Profit share instead adds the products of share percentages along all ownership paths. No external agreements confer control. Unlisted shares are dispersed among unrelated investors, each holding less than 5%; they do not act together. Unlisted ownership links do not exist.
Jasper owns 60.00% of Yarrow.
Yarrow owns 51.00% of Lagoon.
Ember owns 49.00% of Lagoon.

Control and profit share are different. An entity controls an issuer when its own voting shares plus voting shares held by issuers it already controls exceed 50%. Exactly 50% is insufficient. Repeat this rule until no new controlled issuers are found. The ultimate controller is a controller that is not itself controlled by another controller of the target. Profit share instead adds the products of share percentages along all ownership paths. No external agreements confer control. Unlisted shares are dispersed among unrelated investors, each holding less than 5%; they do not act together. Unlisted ownership links do not exist.

Usage is measured at incident time.
The screen panel sublimit cannot be borrowed by a claim under another benefit. Related accessory mentions do not change which item was damaged. Cosmetic damage with no functional loss and ordinary wear are excluded. A technician-confirmed sudden functional failure or accidental impact of the named kind can qualify, subject to all other conditions. Repair and replacement are alternative bases, not cumulative payments; the stated eligible loss already uses the approved basis. Do not add accessory costs that are not part of that loss.

A complete-item claim is assessed under its event mapping even when the same workshop owns other insured equipment. The highest dollar limit in this document is not a selectable alternative. Control and profit share are different. An entity controls an issuer when its own voting shares plus voting shares held by issuers it already controls exceed 50%. Exactly 50% is insufficient. Repeat this rule until no new controlled issuers are found. The ultimate controller is a controller that is not itself controlled by another controller of the target. Unlisted shares are dispersed among unrelated investors, each holding less than 5%; they do not act together. Unlisted ownership links do not exist.

CORPORATE HOLDINGS REGISTER
Control and profit share are different. An entity controls an issuer when its own voting shares plus voting shares held by issuers it already controls exceed 50%. Exactly 50% is insufficient. Repeat this rule until no new controlled issuers are found. The ultimate controller is a controller that is not itself controlled by another controller of the target. Profit share instead adds the products of share percentages along all ownership paths. No external agreements confer control. Unlisted shares are dispersed among unrelated investors, each holding less than 5%; they do not act together. Unlisted ownership links do not exist.

Delta owns 35.00% of Onyx.

CORPORATE HOLDINGS REGISTER
Control and profit share are different. An entity controls an issuer when its own voting shares plus voting shares held by issuers it already controls exceed 50%. Exactly 50% is insufficient. Repeat this rule until no new controlled issuers are found. The ultimate controller is a controller that is not itself controlled by another controller of the target. Profit share instead adds the products of share percentages along all ownership paths. No external agreements confer control. Unlisted shares are dispersed among unrelated investors, each holding less than 5%; they do not act together. Unlisted ownership links do not exist.

CONTRACT EQUIPMENT

OTHER BENEFITS AND ALLOCATION
A complete-item claim is assessed under its event mapping even when the same workshop owns other insured equipment. The highest dollar limit in this document is not a selectable alternative. Where two items share a room, damage to one does not create a claim for the other. There is no stacking of benefit limits, no replacement of a part sublimit by a full-item limit, and no deduction of another benefit's deductible. A beneficiary may not reclassify a component as a whole item to obtain a larger ceiling. All facts needed to identify the single claimed item are in the incident file.

UNSAFE-STORAGE EXCLUSION AND EXCEPTION
An unsafe-storage flag excludes an otherwise covered loss. However, a signed pre-incident storage waiver removes this exclusion for that incident. A post-incident signature is not enough. The waiver affects only unsafe storage; it cannot waive waiting periods, usage limits, purchase status or late reporting. A normal-storage flag never needs a waiver. The incident file explicitly records both the storage status and waiver timing.

BENEFIT B1: camera impact
This benefit applies only to the named event camera impact. A claim for a complete camera and a claim for its lens unit both use this benefit. Its limit is $2500.00; deductible $75.00; the part sublimit is $300.00 and applies only when the claimed item is the lens unit. The complete item has no part sublimit. Waiting period: 14 elapsed calendar days after inception; a loss on the boundary day is eligible. Usage above 500 hours excludes the loss; exactly that usage is allowed. Usage is measured at incident time.
The lens unit sublimit cannot be borrowed by a claim under another benefit. Related accessory mentions do not change which item was damaged. Cosmetic damage with no functional loss and ordinary wear are excluded. A technician-confirmed sudden functional failure or accidental impact of the named kind can qualify, subject to all other conditions. Repair and replacement are alternative bases, not cumulative payments; the stated eligible loss already uses the approved basis. Do not add accessory costs that are not part of that loss.

BENEFIT B3: microphone liquid damage
This benefit applies only to the named event microphone liquid damage. A claim for a complete microphone and a claim for its wireless capsule both use this benefit. Control and profit share are different. An entity controls an issuer when its own voting shares plus voting shares held by issuers it already controls exceed 50%. Exactly 50% is insufficient. Unlisted shares are dispersed among unrelated investors, each holding less than 5%; they do not act together. Unlisted ownership links do not exist.
